description: He wears a long cream linen undertunic with narrow gold-tan geometric collar and cuff borders beneath a plum-purple knee-length open outer tunic with short sleeves and narrow worked front/sleeve/hem edging. A narrow brown leather belt has a simple buckle and long studded hanging end. Brown trousers and tall plain brown leather boots are visible. Both hands hang visibly at his sides. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
